users.name: Michael Torres
users.bio: Macro context, risk management and longer timeframes.

posts.body: BTC and gold are both in my portfolio for different reasons. If your entire macro thesis changes whenever a coin pumps, it might just be a watchlist.
Opened this BTC tranche before adding the rest. Keeping the entry here so the eventual victory lap has an actual receipt attached.
Rejected a salary increase today. I refuse to let guaranteed monthly income weaken my hunger. Payroll say this is the first time anyone has described missing rent as an edge.
The gold purchase from my allocation rebalance. Less exciting than a dog token, but it has never needed an emergency community call.

comments.body: I took a smaller position as well.

posts.body: Three rules: protect capital, size positions, and never explain a losing trade using a photo of yourself on a rented yacht.
Honoured to announce I have been named a Top Voice in Wealth Creation by a website I registered yesterday. Humbled. Relentless. Invoice attached.

comments.body: Congratulations on this completely independent recognition.

posts.body: Sharing the original BTC buy again because a follower asked about the entry. Position size matters more than the motivational caption.

posts.body: ETH looks interesting here, but interesting is not the same as an entry. Watching whether buyers can hold the next pullback.

This BTC buy was a separate allocation decision, not me abandoning ETH after one red afternoon.

comments.body: I took a smaller position as well.

posts.body: Taking a screen-free evening. My positions will still be there tomorrow and staring at them has not once improved the price.

posts.body: ETH entry from the longer-term book. No leverage, no secret indicator, and no paid group required to see the order.

users.name: Priya Shah
users.bio: Charts, levels and a long-term Bitcoin bias.

posts.body: BTC is still inside the range. I have drawn enough lines that one of them will eventually be support. That is called confluence.
Original BTC entry. Before anyone asks, the arrow pointing up was added after the purchase. I am a trader, not a time traveller.
I do not have losing trades. I have unpaid internships in price discovery.
The BNB buy from the journal. The order is real; the claim that I felt absolutely no fear is a branding decision.

comments.body: I took a smaller position as well.

posts.body: My private group has a strict no-refunds policy because conviction is the most important thing in markets. Especially my conviction that I already spent the subscription fees.
People call me a grifter. Incorrect. I am a founder-led educational liquidity redistribution ecosystem. The difference is the font on the invoice.

comments.body: You have successfully disrupted having money.

posts.body: Sold 40 ETH for EUR 44,760 against a EUR 89,550 cost basis. A EUR 44,790 loss. Deliberate. This proves how committed I am to being a grifter: even my own exit liquidity is me. Masterclass link in bio.

comments.body: That is a very expensive way to prove a point nobody disputed.

Bought some BTC alongside the SOL position. Diversification is when two different assets ruin your afternoon.
